_comment: Dedicated one-shot ECS task definition for seeding the investor demo. Register this once, then the operator runs a short `aws ecs run-task` (see DEMO_INVESTOR.md). It mirrors the `command-center` task def (same image + secrets + roles) but overrides the container command to run the seed instead of the web server. Replace every <PLACEHOLDER>. Fill them from your existing `command-center` task def: `aws ecs describe-task-definition --task-definition command-center`.

containerDefinitions.name: demo-seed
containerDefinitions.image: <ECR_IMAGE_URI — same image the service runs, e.g. <acct>.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/plexus/command-center:latest>

secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.valueFrom: <DATABASE_URL_SECRET_ARN — copy from command-center task def secrets[]>

options.awslogs-group: <CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP — e.g. /ecs/plexus-demo-seed (create it, or reuse the service's group)>
